name: ElevenLabs Music Generate
description: Generate a complete music track from a text prompt using ElevenLabs Music. Returns a remote MP3 URL on a CDN. Dynamic pricing of ~$1 per 120 seconds (max 3 min) on the Xona gateway; flat $0.50 on the Orthogonal gateway.

usage.callShape: POST https://api.xona-agent.com/base-main/audio/elevenlabs-music with JSON body {prompt (required), music_length_ms?, output_format?, force_instrumental?}. prompt is the only required field.

inputExample.prompt: a short upbeat acoustic guitar loop

usage.outputShape: body.music_url (remote MP3 URL on DigitalOcean Spaces CDN), body.duration_seconds, body.metadata.model, body.metadata.output_format, body.metadata.music_length_ms, body.metadata.generatedAt, body.metadata.cdn_key
quirks: Same operation via two gateways: Xona (default, dynamic ~$1/120s, max 180000ms) and Orthogonal (flat $0.50). Xona is ~6x cheaper for short clips.
Dynamic pricing on Xona: real charge scales with music_length_ms (10000ms = $0.0833 observed). Set --cap accordingly for longer tracks; max 180000ms (3 min) would cost ~$1.50.
Body field is 'prompt' (required, only required field). Optional on Xona: music_length_ms (1000-180000), output_format (e.g. mp3_standard), force_instrumental (bool).
Output is a remote MP3 URL (body.music_url) on a DigitalOcean Spaces CDN, NOT inline audio bytes — fetch the URL to download the track.
Xona uses x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453); maxTimeoutSeconds 1200 (generation can take a while — allow a long client timeout).

Orthogonal gateway (x402.orth.sh) supports the same op plus extra fields: lyrics_text, composition_plan (object), model_id, seed; output_format is passed as a query param there. Not verified with a paid call (documented from probe).
x402 settlement can fail transiently on-chain ('settle_exact_failed_onchain') returning a 402 with costUsd 0 (no money lost) — retry once.
usage.guide: Generate a complete music track from a text prompt using ElevenLabs Music. Returns a remote MP3 URL on a CDN. Dynamic pricing of ~$1 per 120 seconds (max 3 min) on the Xona gateway; flat $0.50 on the Orthogonal gateway. POST https://api.xona-agent.com/base-main/audio/elevenlabs-music with JSON body {prompt (required), music_length_ms?, output_format?, force_instrumental?}. prompt is the only required field. Output: body.music_url (remote MP3 URL on DigitalOcean Spaces CDN), body.duration_seconds, body.metadata.model, body.metadata.output_format, body.metadata.music_length_ms, body.metadata.generatedAt, body.metadata.cdn_key

usage.callShape: POST https://gg402.vercel.app/compose_music with JSON body {theme, genre}
usage.outputShape: body.lyrics[] (array of strings), body.chords (string), body.melody_description (string), body.processedAt
quirks: inputSchema is empty in the registry — required body is {theme, genre}, BOTH plain strings. Do NOT use 'prompt' or 'text' (returns 400 'Validation failed').
Sending the wrong field names still 400s AFTER payment — you pay even on a validation failure. Send {theme, genre} on the first try.
Output is a TEXT music composition (lyrics, chord progression, prose melody_description) — NOT an audio file/URL. There is no MP3/WAV.
Sync response; no job id / polling.
usage.guide: Call POST https://gg402.vercel.app/compose_music with a JSON body containing exactly two string fields: theme (the mood/subject) and genre (the musical style). Pay $0.01 USDC on Base via x402. The 200 response is synchronous JSON describing a composition: read body.lyrics (array of lines), body.chords (chord progression string), and body.melody_description (prose). Note this is a textual composition, not playable audio. Avoid 'prompt'/'text' field names — they cause a paid 400.

name: Suede AI
description: Suede AI — generate an original, rights-aware music track from a text prompt (genre, mood, instruments). Supports custom lyrics, instrumental-only, vocal gender, and 5–120s duration; returns a shareable audio URL with on-chain provenance/licensing. Pay-per-call x402 (USDC on Base).

usage.callShape: POST https://app.suedeai.xyz/create-music with JSON body {prompt, durationSeconds?, style?, custom_mode?, lyrics?, make_instrumental?, vocal_gender?}

inputExample.prompt: a short upbeat acoustic guitar loop

usage.outputShape: body.shareUrl (shareable HTML page with playable track), body.songId, body.title, body.imageUrl (cover art), body.duration, body.modelVersion. body.trackUrl is the direct audio URL but is null in the immediate response.
quirks: Sync 200 response but body.trackUrl is null at call time — the direct audio URL is not ready immediately; the track finishes generating async. Use body.shareUrl (an HTML page, returns 200) or re-fetch by body.songId to get the listenable audio.
shareUrl host is app.suedeai.ai (.ai) while the API call host is app.suedeai.xyz (.xyz) — different TLD.
durationSeconds is not strictly honored: requesting 5 returned duration 161.
Only 'prompt' is required; make_instrumental:true skips vocals.
usage.guide: POST to https://app.suedeai.xyz/create-music with a JSON body containing at minimum {"prompt":"..."} (pays $0.20 USDC on Base via x402, no API key). Optional fields: durationSeconds (5-120, loosely honored), style, custom_mode, lyrics, make_instrumental (bool), vocal_gender ("m"|"f"). The 200 response is JSON with title, cover imageUrl, songId, and shareUrl, but trackUrl is null because the audio finishes rendering asynchronously — give the user body.shareUrl (a 200 HTML player page) or use body.songId to fetch the final track rather than relying on trackUrl.

name: Music Generation
description: Generate music tracks with Minimax Music 2.5 / 2.5+. Provide a text prompt describing the song; optionally supply lyrics or set instrumental=true. Price scales with duration.

usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/audio/generations with {prompt} (required); optional model/lyrics/instrumental/duration_seconds → returns a generated music track ({url, duration_seconds, lyrics}).
quirks: Dynamic pricing: x-payment-info min $0.02 / max $0.84, scales with duration; a 30s instrumental probe was quoted $0.157500 (157500 atomic USDC).
duration_seconds is only a hint — MiniMax always produces a full-length ~3-min track regardless of the value passed.
Only one model accepted: 'minimax/music-2.5+'. Passing any other model value returns HTTP 400 'Unknown audio model' (this is a validation 400, not a charge).
Sync contract per the live note: generation takes ~1-3 minutes and the response carries the track URL directly — no job id to poll (maxTimeoutSeconds 300 covers the wait).
Payment: USDC on Base (eip155:8453), asset 0x8335...2913, payTo 0xe903...1aBf, scheme exact, x402 v2.
